Langlern modifications to the Supertonic 3 Model (OpenRAIL-M, Section 4(c) notice)

Original Model: Supertone Inc., "Supertonic 3", https://huggingface.co/Supertone/supertonic-3
Pinned upstream commit: 3cadd1ee6394adea1bd021217a0e650ede09a323
License: BigScience Open RAIL-M (Supertonic-OpenRAIL-M.txt in this directory). The use-based
restrictions in its Attachment A apply to the Model, to these modified files and to everyone who
receives them.

Files modified by Langlern (generated by tools/derive-speech-models.py with the pinned tool versions
in tools/requirements-speech.lock.txt; byte-exact SHA-256 values are listed in speech.lock.json):

- models/vector_estimator.onnx: ONNX Runtime 1.23.2 dynamic quantization, uint8 per-channel weights
  for MatMul, Gemm and Conv. Numerical outputs differ from the original Model.
- models/duration_predictor.onnx, models/text_encoder.onnx, models/vocoder.onnx: large float32
  weights stored as float16 and converted back to float32 by inserted Cast nodes. Weights are
  rounded to float16 precision; computation remains float32.

Unmodified upstream files: models/tts.json, models/unicode_indexer.json, voices/M1.json, voices/F3.json.

Langlern additionally normalizes the loudness of generated audio (per sentence, target -16 dBFS
active RMS, peak ceiling -1 dBFS) before playback. Audio produced by this application is
machine-generated speech.
